title: Nea Wonhu no Nne
intro: Wɔ ɔsoro nkitahodi ho abakɔsɛm mu no, onipa bi da nsow a wɔde anwonwade nsɛnkyerɛnne ne gyidi a ɛyɛ pintinn nwene n’asɛm. Saa onipa yi nyaa adiyisɛm soronko bi a ɛkasa tiaa wɔn bere so gyinapɛn ahorow, na ɛkasa fii nkatanim a ɛyɛ mpapahwekwa no akyi. Wɔn nkrasɛm no amfa akwan a wɔtaa fa so so na ɛbae na mmom ɛnam abusuabɔ a emu dɔ a ɛne nnipa ntease nhyia, na ɛfrɛɛ nkurɔfo sɛ wonhu nokware no wɔ akwan a wɔnhwɛ kwan so. Allah akoa yi akwantuo no yɛ adansedie a ɛkyerɛ sɛdeɛ akwankyerɛ tumi da ne ho adi wɔ tebea a ɛyɛ soronko koraa mu, a ɛto nsa frɛ sɛ wɔndwene adiyisɛm ankasa su ho.
clues: Wɔmaa me nkrasɛm bi a ɛnam ahintasɛm nne bi a efi baabi a minhu so bae.
Mfiase no me nkurɔfo pow me nkrasɛm no, na wɔhwehwɛɛ adanse a wɔtaa de di dwuma kɛse a ɛkyerɛ sɛ meyɛ nokware.
Metoo wɔn mpoa sɛ wɔnyɛ biribi a ɛte sɛ nea manya no, nanso wɔantumi.
Wɔkaa adiyisɛm a mede bae no ho asɛm sɛ nkyekyem ahorow a emu da hɔ a ɛma nokware no da adi.
Mebɔɔ me nkurɔfo kɔkɔ sɛ sɛ wɔkɔ so wɔ wɔn gyidi a wonni ne wɔn ahomaso mu a, asotwe a emu yɛ den bɛba wɔn so.
Wɔaka m’asɛm no ho asɛm ka abɔfoɔ foforɔ ho wɔ surah bi a ɛsi Allah tumi Nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ so dua.
